author: Phobiaxx
body:
A combination of three of my favorite maps: Rendezvous, Quintus, and Luar. Took me 10-11 hours to create. Made for gameplay.. since that seem's to be what most people want now, because they are tired of all aesthetic maps that don't really have that good of a gameplay...
Credits:
Rendezvous[ParaPenguin]:The map skeleton reflects off of rendezvous.
Quintus[G_SKIPPY]:The name :P Used some aspects for YAML.
Luar[G_SKIPPY]:The center dock of diamonds. Also, the YAML skeleton.
Aesthetics:
ok.. :P
Gameplay: Should be good.. has water, built in defenses, challenging monuments... and the ability to tunnel directly to the monument(mostly) has the ability to void and skybridge. There is a 5 meter gap between the center and the central attack line, and a 20 meter gap between the two sides(on left and right) should be medium length,,,,
Teams:Darkness[Black] Evil[Red]
Monuments:5
YAML:http://pastebin.com/ApQVR6KH
http://www.mediafire.com/view/u73mbylx1b682r1/Thrice.YAML.txt
Loadout:Full Leather armor, Arrow, Iron Sword, Bow[infinity 56],diamond pickaxe[unbreaking2, ef1], 3 gapples,64oak wood, 64 quartz, 64 glass, 32 bread, nebula shop.
Unique Aspects: Since this map is a combination of many maps... it needs my own creativity... :P
So[Unique Aspects]:cobweb stops before the void.. unique monument style(hovering) void monument, team-troll proof crafting table, secret void diamonds,built-in storage chests...(:o) [Trying to add more.. thanks para C:)

Loadout-armor^
Map Download:http://www.mediafire.com/download/qxqndmkhykaj9dm/Thrice.rar
YAML:
http://pastebin.com/ApQVR6KH
Album:http://imgur.com/a/LTLgP
Leave feedback below! :)

The one thing I'm concerned about is the loadout; I really think you should get some armor, especially since you receive an iron sword.

Overall, this map looks great but needs a few adjustments in my opinion. +1 :D

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
As a hybrid between so many maps, I feel like this lost it's creativity and originality. Looking at the map itself, it seems like instead of inspiration, it was more-so ripped and rearranged than just using elements of the other maps. It's size is not as good as it should be considering the other maps, and aesthetically it seems dull and... missing something. The map itself I feel it may not play well, and of course as a little side note I feel like the defenses provided aren't useful and they're just... there. The theme needs some improvement as well since it's (kind of) boring but I don't quite know what theme you're trying to achieve ((whether it be simple or not)). Onto some good feedback, I like how the islands break off and how the webs are there to give the user some time to place water/wood to save themselves, and this makes tunneling unique. There's a fair amount of iron as well, and all in all it seems fine but not quite our quality.

Sorry if I seemed harsh, I don't mean to be like that. I encourage you to build off these suggestions/improvements to make you become a better mapmaker :D
